records.title: Measures
records.treatment: Compare the specified attribute and align length starts.
records.adopted: Keep length comparisons on one baseline; order by the stated attribute rather than colour.
records.rejected: Do not infer weight from drawing size or assess units/number fluency through ordering rods.
records.usageRestrictions: Original Finnish explanations, examples and SVGs; no source text or diagrams copied. Reference only.
records.limits: Source informs attribute comparison; our choose-next implementation and equal-tie acceptance are project design, not efficacy evidence.

records.title: Use manipulatives and representations to develop understanding
records.treatment: Link manipulation explicitly to the represented mathematical idea.
records.adopted: Move real ribbons then show corresponding ordered diagram. Keep surface decoration away from the comparison.
records.rejected: Choosing one middle rod is not treated as constructing an entire order.
records.usageRestrictions: No copied figures/prose; original lesson. Source reuse requires separate permission/licence check beyond references.
records.limits: Teacher guidance is not a validation of this digital lesson or the full age1–6 band.

inventory.intro: Order sticks or numbers by a stated direction.
inventory.demo: orderScene chooses shortest remaining then numeric ascending/descending.
inventory.items: sticks/numbers/fix construct token-slot order; middle only recognizes a middle rod.
inventory.hints: Find minimum remaining; numeric examples compare tens thenones.
inventory.transfer: Order fictional character ages from provided numeric facts.
inventory.audit: Reports orderScene,3demos andfix family; older COVERAGE row missesfix.

alignment.inherited: Choose next remaining item; ascending/descending and contextual transfer.
alignment.extended: Equal-length rods accept either relative order.
alignment.corrected: Do not claim middle-recognition proves fullconstruction. Numeric/age comparisons require those targetdomain skills; not covert prerequisites for rod version.

planning.assumed: Visual length comparison is modelled; M-MEAS00 support may be offered. Numbers/ages not required in checked rod activity.
planning.scope: Construct complete order by pictured positive lengths, both directions and equal ties; not all realworld attribute domains.
planning.evidenceLimits: Actual construction checks pictured rods only; no general mastery, physical measurement or retention award. No savedhistory.
